name: @ocelli/bench
description: The benchmark harness HLD section 26 names (F-006). A subject registry, a runner per subject that has a subject, and a recorded baseline per host class.
$pins: playwright is pinned at exactly 1.62.1, with no caret and no tilde, and it is the SAME pin tools/oracle/package.json carries. scripts/bench_check.py asserts the two are equal, so drift fails rather than being remembered.

The two harnesses get their own installs on purpose. Sharing one would couple the benchmark's story to the comparator's, and this sprint already has enough coupling in that area. A drifting browser build between them would silently make them report different environments, which is exactly the kind of difference a host class exists to catch.
$why_no_other_dependency: There is no cornerstone3D here and there is no bundler. The page loads the wasm-pack glue that bin/ocelli.sh wasm already generates, as a browser would, and nothing is bundled, so a bundler could not change the module graph between two runs.

criterion is deliberately absent. The decode.frame Rust subject uses std::time::Instant in a release example, so it needs no benchmark-only Cargo dependency and remains visible to cargo check --all-targets.

scripts.test: node --test tests/hostclass_test.mjs tests/paths_test.mjs tests/record_test.mjs tests/registry_test.mjs tests/run_test.mjs tests/state_test.mjs tests/cold_start_test.mjs tests/decode_frame_test.mjs
